-- AAC Phase 1D
CREATE TEMP TABLE valid_link AS
SELECT
  il.link_id,
  il.campaign_id,
  il.doctor_id,
  d.practice_id,
  il.topic_id,
  CONCAT('interview_', REPLACE(il.link_id, '-', '')) AS interview_id
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.interview_links` il
JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d
  ON d.doctor_id = il.doctor_id
WHERE
  il.secure_token_hash = TO_HEX(SHA256(@token))
  AND il.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  AND il.status IN ('READY', 'OPENED')
  AND il.used_at IS NULL
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY il.created_at DESC) = 1;

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.interviews` T
USING (
  SELECT
    interview_id,
    campaign_id,
    doctor_id,
    practice_id,
    topic_id,
    'INTERVIEW_COMPLETED' AS status,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(@started_at AS TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS started_at,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(@completed_at AS TIMESTAMP), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS completed_at,
    @transcript AS transcript,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS audio_storage_uri,
    TO_JSON(STRUCT(
      SAFE.PARSE_JSON(@history_json) AS realtime_history,
      'browser_realtime' AS capture_source
    )) AS interview_metadata
  FROM valid_link
) S
ON T.interview_id = S.interview_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  status = S.status,
  started_at = S.started_at,
  completed_at = S.completed_at,
  transcript = S.transcript,
  audio_storage_uri = S.audio_storage_uri,
  interview_metadata = S.interview_metadata,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT (
    interview_id, campaign_id, doctor_id, practice_id, topic_id, status,
    started_at, completed_at, transcript, audio_storage_uri,
    interview_metadata, created_at, updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
    S.interview_id, S.campaign_id, S.doctor_id, S.practice_id, S.topic_id, S.status,
    S.started_at, S.completed_at, S.transcript, S.audio_storage_uri,
    S.interview_metadata, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  );

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.interview_links`
SET
  status = 'USED',
  used_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  interview_id = (SELECT interview_id FROM valid_link LIMIT 1)
WHERE link_id IN (SELECT link_id FROM valid_link);

UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_doctors`
SET
  status = 'INTERVIEW_COMPLETED',
  interview_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE campaign_id IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM valid_link)
  AND doctor_id IN (SELECT doctor_id FROM valid_link);

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(
  event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp,
  source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload
)
SELECT
  GENERATE_UUID(),
  'interview',
  interview_id,
  'interview.completed',
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  'browser+n8n',
  NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(
    campaign_id,
    doctor_id,
    topic_id,
    LENGTH(@transcript) AS transcript_characters
  ))
FROM valid_link;

SELECT
  IF(v.interview_id IS NOT NULL, 'true', 'false') AS valid,
  IF(v.interview_id IS NOT NULL, 'INTERVIEW_COMPLETED', 'INVALID_OR_ALREADY_USED') AS status,
  v.interview_id,
  v.campaign_id,
  v.doctor_id,
  v.topic_id
FROM (SELECT 1 AS seed) s
LEFT JOIN valid_link v
ON TRUE;

## AAC Phase 1D - Interview Completion

Receives the finished browser voice interview and persists it to BigQuery.

On success:
- stores readable transcript + raw Realtime history
- marks the interview link USED
- updates campaign_doctors to INTERVIEW_COMPLETED
- logs `interview.completed`

After import, connect the existing BigQuery credential. Test before activating.
